verdict.rationale: Vapi documents SIP calling: any SIP client or softphone can dial an assistant's SIP URI. That suggests external SIP endpoints can reach Vapi without bundled numbers, but the docs shown cover softphone testing rather than carrier or PBX trunk configuration. Missing for 10: documented BYO SIP trunk or PBX integration (trunk credentials, outbound via own carrier), Twilio/Telnyx number import, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
